headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 6, 2026**
article:
The Seattle Mariners secured a dominant 4-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Bryce Miller pitching 6.0 innings of shutout baseball. Dominic Canzone led the Mariners' offense with a 3-hit, 2-RBI performance, including his 8th home run of the season. The Kansas City Royals took down the Minnesota Twins 3-2, with Carter Jensen leading the offense and Matt Strahm earning the win. The St. Louis Cardinals outlasted the Cincinnati Reds 6-5 in a closely contested matchup, with Matt McLain leading the Reds with a home run and two RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Quinn Priester, a right-hander for the Milwaukee Brewers, has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right thoracic outlet syndrome. Tyler Glasnow, a right-hander for the Los Angeles Dodgers, has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with low back spasms. Austin Wells, a catcher for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list with cervical headaches. Gustavo Campero, a catcher for the Los Angeles Angels, has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hand fracture. Jorge Soler, a designated hitter for the Los Angeles Angels, has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 4, 2026, with a left oblique strain.

The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher Antoine Kelly from the Los Angeles Dodgers in a trade. The Milwaukee Brewers have acquired right-hander Joel Kuhnel from the Athletics in a trade. The Boston Red Sox have acquired left-hander Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates in a trade. The Cincinnati Reds have traded right-hander Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Los Angeles Angels have traded catcher Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash.
